Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 3 (test build)

Test build with notices for declined connections and pairings, recovery fixes and a capacity self-test.

Status

Status
Retired (final notice)
Published
2026-10-06
End date
2026-10-13

Final notice: this release ends on 2026-10-13. Approve the update in your app before then; a vault still on this release afterwards can no longer be opened.

Changes

  • A declined connection request or a rejected device pairing is reported to the other side (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.10.5).
  • Recovery records when it was registered, and the vault keeps the credential backup setting (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.10.6).
  • Fixes from the first staging tests (queue recreation, lock logging, recovery test vectors) and a capacity measurement in the self-test.
  • Built from vettid-vault commit 5cd11db (tag release/staging/3), the first release built on the ubuntu-26.04-arm runners, and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-05 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix
